02 — The shift

Content Is Everywhere.

AI has made content production faster. A business can now turn an idea into an article, a video, a social post or an entire campaign in a fraction of the time it used to take.

That creates an interesting problem.

When more businesses can produce more content, audiences have more to consume but less reason to pay attention to any particular business.

This is where trust becomes important. People still want to know who is behind the business. They want to understand how that person thinks, what they have experienced, and whether they genuinely understand the problem they are trying to solve.

Why should I believe you?
03 — The human advantage

Your Expertise Matters.

Every business has knowledge that cannot be found in a content template.

It might come from years of working with customers. A difficult problem you had to solve. A lesson you learned after making the wrong decision. A particular way of explaining something that your customers immediately understand.

These experiences shape how you think about your work. They also give people something they can use to understand who you are and what you stand for.

Most businesses don't lack things to say. They lack the time, process and perspective needed to find what is worth saying.

That's the part we help with.

Case Study 01 · Jul–Dec 2025

Building an online presence for a new category: digital estate planning.

The client · Sampul.co

Sampul.co is a Shariah-compliant digital estate planning platform founded by Arham Merican, a Shariah Adviser registered with the Securities Commission Malaysia and former Head of Shariah & Governance at Bursa Suq Al-Sila'. Backed by funding from Yayasan Peneraju, Sampul needed Malaysians to know it exists and why estate planning can no longer wait.

The challenge

Sampul came to us for podcast content. But a podcast built on the wrong assumptions would talk to the wrong people.

What we found

Discovery showed that Sampul's real audience behaved differently from the traditional trustee and will-writing audience it had been benchmarking against. The people most likely to adopt digital estate planning were already managing money digitally through investment apps, e-wallets, digital banking and takaful.

So we changed the reference point. Sampul's online presence should be benchmarked against digital finance brands, not trustee firms.

What we built

Di Sebalik Sampul, a 10-episode educational podcast hosted by CanvasLab co-founder Radzi, designed for a digitally fluent audience and distributed across YouTube, TikTok and Instagram.

Results · All channels from zero

1M+cumulative views across platforms
5Kfollowers across TikTok, Facebook and Instagram
1.25KYouTube subscribers for long-form educational content
50K+YouTube views within three months

Consistently positive, substantive comments on YouTube.

This was an awareness and education campaign. Conversion was not part of the scope.

Client perspective

“Working with CanvasLab was one of the best decisions we made for Sampul's media presence. Radzi and Suhail took the time to really understand our needs, our brand, and the audience we wanted to reach.”

Arham Merican · Founder, Sampul.co

Case Study 02 · Jan–Jun 2025

Making mental health education approachable, and turning attention into enquiries.

The client · MINDAKAMI

MINDAKAMI is a mental health centre in Petaling Jaya. Its team of registered counsellors and clinical psychologists supports children, adults, couples and families. After relocating, the centre wanted to take content seriously for the first time. It had no prior social media presence.

The challenge

Mental health is technical and sensitive. Content had to be accurate enough to respect clinical standards, and simple enough for a scrolling audience to actually watch. The practitioners also spoke confidently in sessions but froze in front of a camera.

It felt like a heart-to-heart on a couch rather than a lecture.

What we did
  • Studied the topic before producing anything. Each subject was researched in depth so every video was grounded in substance, not trends.
  • Replaced the lecture with a conversation. Recordings became relaxed sit-down conversations, with Radzi as interviewer.
  • Kept clinical integrity in the loop. Every piece was checked directly with MINDAKAMI's practitioners.
  • Built a bench of voices. 10–13 videos were produced for each counsellor and psychologist.

Results · TikTok · Jan–Jun 2025

12.2Kfollowers in six months, from zero
1.3Mviews from late February to June alone
69Klikes and 2,576 comments
6,345shares
202Kviews on the top video
180Kviews on the second

TikTok analytics, 23 Feb – 29 Jun 2025.

Viewers started reaching out directly through TikTok to ask about counselling services and how to book appointments.
